source: CRU CL 2.0 (New, Lister, Hulme and Makin 2002, Climate Research 21:1-25), 10-minute mean monthly climate, 1961-1990, land only; https://crudata.uea.ac.uk/cru/data/hrg/tmc/; Open Database License
projection: plain lon/lat (EPSG:4326) cells, equal steps in degrees
order: arrays [month 0-11, Jan-Dec][row, north to south][col, west to east]; cell (r, c) spans lat north - r*cell_deg .. north - (r+1)*cell_deg, lon west + c*cell_deg .. west + (c+1)*cell_deg; null = sea or no data

temperature.units: tenths of a degree C (divide by 10)
